content: If you or someone near you is experiencing a medical emergency such as chest pain, difficulty breathing, loss of consciousness, severe bleeding, stroke symptoms, or any other life-threatening condition, please call your local emergency services immediately or proceed to the nearest hospital emergency department without delay. This clinic provides scheduled outpatient consultations and is not equipped to handle acute emergencies; do not wait for a clinic appointment in a life-threatening situation. Clinic staff who witness a medical emergency on clinic premises will follow in-house emergency protocols and summon emergency services on your behalf. After a medical emergency, patients are encouraged to contact the clinic to update their medical records and to schedule appropriate follow-up care with their treating specialist. The clinic's administrative support agent is not able to provide clinical triage, diagnose conditions, or advise on emergency treatment.
